info.title: Recogno API
info.description:
Backend for Recogno, a spaced-repetition trainer for DSA and system-design pattern recognition.

The drill loop is: `GET /drill/next` for a problem stripped of its answer, `POST /drill/submit` to grade a guess and advance its FSRS card, `GET /drill/due-count` for the reps-due badge.

get.description:
Returns the statement and constraints only. The ground-truth pattern and the tell are withheld until the guess is submitted.

Prefers an SRS card that is due, then a problem never seen, then the soonest-due card.

post.summary: Submit a guess and advance the schedule
post.description:
Grades correctness, speed and rationale, combines them into a composite, maps that onto an FSRS rating, and upserts the SRS card. Reveals the tell in the response.

A wrong guess cannot exceed the Hard band however fast or well argued it was, and a correct guess with no real reasoning lands there too.

post.summary: Add a problem and record the first attempt
post.description:
Accepts a link, a slug or a free-text description, together with the note and solution.

Returns immediately with a queued submission: resolving the source and running the AI evaluation happen on the worker. Poll `GET /submissions/{id}` for progress.

Adding a problem that already exists in the deck records another attempt against it rather than failing.

post.summary: Accept or override the grade, and reschedule
post.description:
The final gradation drives FSRS. Omit `gradation` to accept the AI's verdict; supply one to override it.

A submission whose evaluation failed can still be committed, but only with an explicit gradation — the learner self-grades rather than losing the attempt.

gradation.description: Overrides the AI's grade. Required when the evaluation failed.
